I've noticed that all the images I upload, whether by file or remote URL, are converted to PNG. Is there a particular reason for this? Wouldn't that drastically increase the amount of disk space and bandwidth consumed?
Why are all images converted to PNG?

Fun computer fact: Extensions are meaningless. An operating system can use extensions as a hint for which program to open when you double-click a file, but there's nothing guaranteeing a png file will actually contain data in the png format, and in this case it doesn't.

I mean, the png format can't be animated, but you can upload a gif, load it with the png extension, and it plays just fine.

So why do all files have the png extension? I screwed up the code design so the format info doesn't get where it needs to be, and fixing it would take an hour or three, so I haven't bothered yet. I'm reprogramming the site anyway, though, so I'll probably fix this issue in the process.

Until then, you can just manually change the url of any image to .jpg or .gif and it should work just fine.
